translations.web: If the latter husband hates her, and write her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;
translations.bsb: and the second man hates her, writes her a certificate of divorce, hands it to her, and sends her away from his house, or if he dies,
translations.kjv: And if the latter husband hate her, and write her a bill of divorcement, and giveth it in her hand, and sendeth her out of his house; or if the latter husband die, which took her to be his wife;
